# Inquestra

> Local-first, MIT-licensed Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) with native Chromium W3C Web Serial hardware capture, chemical inventory LIMS, and deterministic SHA-256 provenance.

- Official Website: https://inquestra.org
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/kaleb973/Inquestra
- Founder & Lead Maintainer: Kaleb (https://github.com/kaleb973)
- Contact & Support: https://inquestra.org/contact (support@inquestra.org)

## Key Public Pages

- [Home](https://inquestra.org/): Overview of the local-first ELN, Web Serial DAQ, and SHA-256 record sealing.
- [About](https://inquestra.org/about): Project background, maintainer information (Kaleb / github.com/kaleb973), open-source details, and how to support development.
- [Compare ELNs](https://inquestra.org/compare): Side-by-side comparison of Inquestra, Benchling, LabArchives, and SciNote.
- [Benchling Alternative](https://inquestra.org/compare/benchling-alternative): Multi-disciplinary ELN and self-hosted PostgreSQL comparison.
- [LabArchives Alternative](https://inquestra.org/compare/labarchives-alternative): Block-canvas workspace and hardware DAQ comparison.
- [Hardware DAQ](https://inquestra.org/hardware): W3C Web Serial stream formats for ESP32-S3, Teensy 4.1, Arduino, nRF52840, RP2040, and USB/RS-232 benchtop instruments.
- [System Architecture](https://inquestra.org/architecture): Browser localStorage persistence, W3C Web Serial 500-sample preview buffering with full CSV/ZIP export, and optional self-hosted PostgreSQL sync via Prisma.
- [Cryptographic Provenance](https://inquestra.org/provenance): Deterministic SHA-256 trial sealing, append-only audit logs, and ZIP/Markdown/CSV exports.
- [Interactive Demo](https://inquestra.org/demo): In-browser simulated serial DAQ and SHA-256 sealing walkthrough.
- [FAQ](https://inquestra.org/faq): Answers on zero-signup local mode, academic access, serial hardware, sequences, chemistry tools, and data export.
- [Contact](https://inquestra.org/contact): Support and legal/privacy contact channels (`support@inquestra.org`, `legal@inquestra.org`).

## Excluded Application Routes

- `/app/*`, `/scan`, and `/api/*` are interactive workspace/API endpoints marked `noindex, nofollow` and disallowed in `robots.txt`.
